#### Description

Interface MAC is overwriten by systemd udev-rules, specifically /usr/lib/systemd/network/99-default.link:

```
[Match]
OriginalName=*

[Link]
NamePolicy=keep kernel database onboard slot path
AlternativeNamesPolicy=database onboard slot path
MACAddressPolicy=persistent
```

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run this script in teamd container (autorestart of teamd container is disabled)

```
#!/bin/bash
while :; do
        pkill -9 teamd;
        ip link del PortChannel100 ;
        rm -rf /var/run/teamd/PortChannel100.pid;
        /usr/bin/teamd -r -t PortChannel100 -c '{"device":"PortChannel100","hwaddr":"7c:fe:90:79:c9:00","runner":{"active":true,"name":"lacp"}}' -L /var/warmboot/teamd/ -g -d ;
        ip link set dev PortChannel100 up ; 
        ip link show PortChannel100;
        ip link show PortChannel100 | grep '7c:fe' || { echo "!!!!Reproduced!!!!"; exit 1; }
done
```


#### Describe the results you received:

```
root@arc-switch1025:/# bash -x ./test.sh 
+ :
+ pkill -9 teamd
+ ip link del PortChannel100
Cannot find device "PortChannel100"
+ rm -rf /var/run/teamd/PortChannel100.pid
+ /usr/bin/teamd -r -t PortChannel100 -c '{"device":"PortChannel100","hwaddr":"7c:fe:90:79:c9:00","runner":{"active":true,"name":"lacp"}}' -L /var/warmboot/teamd/ -g -d
Using team device "PortChannel100".
Using PID file "/var/run/teamd/PortChannel100.pid"
This program is not intended to be run as root.
+ ip link set dev PortChannel100 up
+ ip link show PortChannel100
173: PortChannel100: <NO-CARRIER,BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP> mtu 1500 qdisc noqueue state DOWN mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether b2:06:cf:53:a0:b5 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
+ ip link show PortChannel100
+ grep 7c:fe
+ echo '!!!!Reproduced!!!!'
!!!!Reproduced!!!!
+ exit 1

```

#### Describe the results you expected:

Interface MAC should be a router MAC from DEVICE_METADATA.

linkedPullRequests.title: [systemd] disable default systemd udev rules for interfaces
linkedPullRequests.author: stepanblyschak
linkedPullRequests.body:

     Please provide the following information:

#### Why I did it
Fix #7364 

99-default.link - was always in SONiC, but previous systemd (<247) had an issue and it did not work due to issue systemd/systemd#3374. Now systemd 247 works.

However, such policy overrides teamd provided mac address which causes teamd netdev to use a random mac 
address. Therefore, needs to be disabled.

#### How I did it
Disable default systemd udev rules for interfaces.

#### How to verify it

Execute https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/7364 reproduction script.

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body:
1.	I update PR 7369, @Stepan Blyshchak, can you check if it is accurate?
2.	Other than teamd netdev, are you aware of any other netdev is affected?
3.	Instead of disable the 99-default.link, is it the same effect if we set the macpolicy=none?

comments.author: stepanblyschak
comments.body:
1. Thanks, it is accurate.
2. I was focued on team devices, but this can happen to phy port netdevs and this was observed by our team
3. Yes, according to what man pages say, although I find it safer to disable it completely to not have to worry about debian upsteam changes in 99-default.link. What do you think?

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: since /etc/systemd/network override /usr/lib/systemd/network, i think it is better to provide our own policy explicitly. we can provide a file with mac address policy as none and copy to /etc/systemd/network, it would be better since in the future we may want to customize the other policy as well.
